scientific_integrity: A proof for all primes and positive depths is given by an exact orthogonal-projection decomposition; all numerical checks are finite and independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unit residues and prime-power moduli only. Broader ultrametric covariance-kernel results may imply this arithmetic specialization; absence of an equivalent prior formula is not conclusively certified.
title: Geometric-square covariance spectrum of shifted Menon gcd statistics
